note: libngspice (KiCad 10.0.6, econ-core, 2026-10-31) runs of OUR deck (pcb.custom.kicad_spice.build_deck) with the whole board at each temperature (.temp); "parts" = the board at 25 C with D1 at its own 100 C (instance temp=). Every  point kept. Reference for tmp-1 / tmp-2. Only the vectors of the schematic's own nodes are kept (the op-amp subcircuit's internal nodes dropped).

-40.deck:
.title Polari deck (kxc-3, from the ingested rows)
.include "ad8051.lib"
.temp -40
.ac dec 10 1 1Meg

C1 /lowpass Net-_C1-Pad2_ 100n
C2 Net-_U1-+_ GND 100n
R1 Net-_C1-Pad2_ Net-_R1-Pad2_ 1k
R2 Net-_U1-+_ Net-_C1-Pad2_ 1k
V1 Net-_R1-Pad2_ GND DC 0 AC 1
V2 VDD GND DC 10
V3 GND VSS DC 10
XU1 Net-_U1-+_ /lowpass VDD VSS /lowpass AD8051
.end
